unit: symmetry class (key: level-3 bottom to 7 dp + level-4 class-count multiset); one representative per class; FR30 represents its class
target: Y4 = level-4 pinned bottom (LOBPCG residual <= 1e-7); flux-corrected residual r4 = Y4 - flux model fitted on the training fold
partition: children = depth-1 subtrees (tile index // 512); surface of a child = its tiles with a panel neighbour outside the child or missing; interior = rest

descriptors.gp_k: lambda_min(P_k^dag K(E) P_k) - c1, k Kramers pairs per child, multiplets completed
descriptors.kmin: lambda_min(K(E)) -- exact reformulation control, excluded from mechanism claims

cv: rule-level 10-fold, 20 repetitions, seeds 20261024+r; ridge alpha by inner 5-fold CV over (1e-3..100)
interventions: 18 Phase V-B level-4 controls, never in training
decision: mechanism supported only if M3 or M4 (no target-derived quantity) beats M0, M1 AND M2 out of sample by more than 2 sd of the repetition spread, explains a majority of FR30's leave-out residual, and tracks the intervention residuals (corr > 0.5)
